description: Gives the broad group-wide fair price for a kind of product: the median entry monthly price per buyer tier across its whole product group. Use this when you want a general price guide: give a task or product type (or a group_id from the group price league) and get the fair price for each buyer tier (individual, pro, team / small business, enterprise) with its typical range, the group's typical payment models (free, subscription, usage, one-time, contact sales), usage and one-time medians where at least 3 listings publish them, and the group's 90-day price-index change. Groups are built from what products do, not from price. Medians of current published prices only; individual listings are not returned. Call with no arguments to list group IDs. Use price_benchmark instead to check a specific quote against the closest comparables; search_providers for candidates.

group_id.description: Optional: a group id from agentery.com/aepi/groups or from get_provider_profile's product_group.

query.description: The task or product type, e.g. 'AI meeting notes for sales teams'.

name: get_group_fair_price

outputSchema.description: JSON result; identical to the text content block.

title: Get group fair price
